title: Hearing Buddy Bolden as a boy at Globe Hall
summary: He heard Bolden while learning, at Globe Hall and other halls, with an unusable repeated passage at the end.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: Tell us about Bowling. Did you ever, you heard Bowling when you were a boy, I guess?

I used to play flute them times, I heard Bowling. That's how I learned how to play. I used to play clarinet thing. I used to get that out the hall, at the Gloves Hall, or either at the Column 8 or 9, he didn't play at the Column 8 much, or at the Gloves.
Did he play at the Perseverance Hall, I think somebody said too, maybe down there on the?
Yeah, I don't know. How many?
Durden Street. Durden Street. He didn't play that much neither.
Where was the Globe Hall? That's right by the, you see where the auditorium was?
Right there. Is it still there, that building? No, it broke down. That's where they had to take it down to the building of the auditorium.
I thought maybe it was on St. Peter's. It was still there. It was big place, sure, yeah. It's torn down.
I wondered. And old Bowling used to blow them down there, I'm telling you.
That's the part of the strong farm, I think. All the way through. It never, never come here and come down. It's put it down there. It's all regained.
